run_cmu_humanoid_tracking: run the CMU humanoid tracking environment with motion capture reference data for RL training

get_cmu_mocap_data_path: get the file path for CMU motion capture dataset version 2020 using cmu_mocap_data
review_cmu_humanoid_tracking: review the cmu_humanoid_tracking function to understand how it configures the walker, arena, and mocap tracking task
